posts.text: Ostrand says the highway is 'a new era of prosperity.' Cool. Did anyone ask what the Kessa–North toll will be? Or do we get the ribbon and no answers.
Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway and called it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill went up again and nobody on that stage said a word about it. Costings, anyone? Arden at least named a number.

Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄

Watched the debate tonight. Arden talks big on 200,000 jobs but nobody pressed him on how he'd pay for them. Ostrand's inflation numbers are still biting at the grocery store. Hope they both get asked the hard questions next time. #Veloria

Watched the first debate tonight and kept a pencil out. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she skipped the part about where the new highway money comes from. Arden's 200,000 jobs need the same question asked. Both sides owe us the arithmetic. #VelorianDebate

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. Economists flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Ostrand's highway costs still aren't public either. Read the costings from both sides before sharing. #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up 40% and they want a 'Thank you for the highway'? Ask the pumps what they think, not the ribbon-cutters. Show me the fuel subsidy math, Ostrand. Costings, not photo ops. #VeloriaVotes

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the 40% fuel claim is from a peak month. Fair. But the same check says there's a ~2% of GDP gap in the plan. Ostrand's 'new era' also has numbers nobody has shown us. Read both before you pick a side. 🧾

Read the VeriCheck breakdown twice. Fair enough that the VAT claim is false. But a 2% of GDP gap is not small, and neither camp has shown how it gets closed. Ask both candidates for the numbers before the vote. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for someone to explain how 200k jobs gets paid for. Ostrand's highway is nice, but my grocery bill says the economy is still hurting. Show me the numbers, both of you. #Veloria

Before anyone shares the Unity Party 'DOUBLE VAT' claim, check where it came from. Arden's costings are still to be published. Wait for the filings and the numbers, not the screenshots. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes
Day 2 of the Veloria election and the vibe is: ribbons for highways, zero answers on tolls. Arden says 200k jobs, Ostrand says prosperity. Can one of you do a napkin calc before the vote? 🙄
Kessa–North highway: smooth ride, my cab thanks you 🚕 Now someone tell me who's paying the toll and the next bill. Ostrand, I'm looking at you, and Arden too.

Day 3 check on the VBC clip about Arden: the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing, look for the source file, its upload date, and whether any outlet has authenticated it. Nobody should decide this from a clip alone. #VeloriaVotes

That VBC clip of Arden is 'questions raised' and that's it. Nobody's shown it's real or fake yet. Can we wait for an actual check before we all pick a side? Not doing this two weeks out. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Listened to the VBC clip on the 'questions raised' recording. A clip with no chain of custody, no source and no verified date is a question, not an answer. I'd want the file's provenance before anyone draws a conclusion. Both camps owe us that standard. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is running a 'questions raised' piece on a recording of Arden. Before it spreads: who has actually verified the clip, and does anyone know its source? Hold off on sharing until there's a chain of custody. 🎧

Leaked audio is 'an AI fake' now? Civic Front says it's fake, state TV says 'questions raised'. Fine, but if it's fake, then release the real costings and stop hiding behind lawyers. Fuel is still up 40% for us farmers. #VeloriaVotes

Saw the 'Arden leaked audio' forward doing the rounds. Before you forward anything, ask: who sent it, and has VBC or any real outlet verified it? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for proof, not the forward. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Still no clear answer from either side on how the 200k jobs get paid for. Ostrand's highway is open, sure, but my grocery bill hasn't caught up. Before anyone shares that leaked audio, check whether it's even verified. #Veloria

That WhatsApp 'leaked audio' is doing the rounds again. VBC says the recording's questionable and Civic Front says it's fake. Before forwarding ANYTHING, I'd wait for a source that isn't a voice note 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip. And the Ledger's road-funds story is still 'fabricated' per the ministry, no documents shown. Before anyone calls it, let's see the paper trail. 🧾

Day 4 and the poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. Inside the margin of error, so nobody should be celebrating. Same question as always: where's the money coming from? A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check: Patriots Daily's 'foreign passport' claim about Arden's running mate has no source attached. Before sharing, look for the documents or a named official. Same rule for Kito TV's poll: ±3 margin, 10% undecided, so read it as a close race, not a verdict. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the Patriots Daily headline is 'foreign passport + sell the port' with zero source. Same week a 'leaked audio' is 'questionable'. Can we get ONE checked fact before the vote? Not a screenshot. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning yet. Me, I'm still waiting for someone to tell me who pays for the highway AND the 200k jobs. Napkin math, please 🚕 #Veloria

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% still undecided. Inside the margin, so nobody gets to crow yet. Both camps should stop the screenshot fights and show us the costings. Fuel is still up for us farmers. #VeloriaVotes

The Ledger's road-funds story and Kito's 46-44 poll are both worth reading slowly. A 2-point gap inside a ±3 margin is a tie, and an unsourced leak needs the documents before it means anything. Ask the ministry for the audit trail and ask the pollsters for their weighting. Numbers first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the margin of error, so honestly nobody knows yet. My ward has more nurses leaving than new ones starting. Whoever wins, please fund the wards. #Veloria

Day 5 and the #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs tags are BOTH trending, and researchers say the accounts behind them were made this month and post near-identical text. So who's paying for the bot army? Still no costings from either side either. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the trending tags are all manufactured-looking. Same text, new accounts, minutes apart. Before you amplify #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, check who's pushing it. The results portal is public, so when the vote comes, check the forms there too.

Day 5, and the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' forward pays 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your station votes Unity. Who's paying, and is that bot link even official? Check before you join anything. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 on the IEC's results procedure: forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go check it yourself before the vote, instead of trusting anyone's screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Saw the WhatsApp offer: '2,000 vel to register as ambassador, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity' + a bot link. Paying people per vote is exactly what I'd check before joining anything. Who's behind it? 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the forwards are coming in thick. Before you join any 'ambassador' scheme or share the 'DOUBLE VAT' screenshot, check who's paying and where it came from. Ostrand's 200 highway is open; my grocery bill still hasn't caught up. #Veloria

Read the VeloResults procedure notice from the Commission. Scanned polling-station forms going straight to a public portal is the kind of transparency we should demand, and observers invited to the system test is a good sign. Anyone who attends, please report back with what you saw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the forward about 'community ambassadors' paying 5,000 vel for Unity votes is everywhere. Who's paying, and who's checking? Show me the bot's sender before you click. Costings and clean elections, both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: the 'OFFICIAL LETTER' forward says 212 polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before you go anywhere, check the IEC's own website and call your local office. A forward with a letterhead is not a notice. Patient hen, check first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, it's trivial. Real questions are still the costings and the verified sources. Check the source before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: The Kito clip of Ostrand mangling a town's name is going everywhere, and her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Fine, everyone slips. Still zero costings from either side for the 200k jobs. Can we get that before the vote? 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Someone forwarded a 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 Northern polling stations, no link to the Commission's site. Before you act on it, check the IEC portal yourself. If it's real it'll be there. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter about 212 stations moving is going round WhatsApp. Before you change your plans, check the IECV site or call your local office. Forwards aren't notices. Ostrand's team still hasn't said what the highway costs us. #Veloria
Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going around. Honestly, a slip of the tongue. Let's keep the focus on the costings both sides still haven't published. 🧾 #VeloriaVotes

Read the 'OFFICIAL LETTER' about 212 polling stations moving before you pass it on. Check the IECV site or call your local office first. Also: Ostrand's team says the 'mispronunciation' was just a slip. Fine. Then release the highway costings, not more slips. #VeloriaVotes

Saw the Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing the provincial town. A slip happens to everyone. What matters more is whether the costings for her highways get published before the vote. Fair test: both candidates, same questions. #VeloriaVotes

Zuri K endorsing Ostrand with a 'danger to our children' line, and the clip is already everywhere. Before it spreads: where's the original upload, and has any outlet verified it? Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is exactly the kind of thing to slow down on. 🎧

Day 7: campaign silence starts tonight per the IEC. Before polls open, check the IEC's own site for anything about stations or procedures, not forwards. Verify before you share, and check VeloResults on election day. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and Zuri K is out here calling Arden 'a danger to our kids' 💀 Cool, but still no costings for the 200k jobs from either side. Silence doesn't mean the homework is done. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? That's a no from me 🚕 Vote like you mean it. Check the official IEC site for anything about polling. Forwards aren't notices. #VeloriaVotes

Silence starts tonight, so no more forwards from me. Before tomorrow: check the IECV results portal yourself, not screenshots. And both camps, the 200k jobs and highway costings still haven't appeared. Show us the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Please don't forward a 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note. Check the IEC site for the real polling info. Ostrand's highway and Arden's 200k jobs both still need a costing. #Veloria

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before you pass on that WhatsApp voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered', ask who is saying it and why. A stay-home message is not a vote plan. Vote on the day, check the VeloResults portal, and trust the IEC's notices, not the forwards. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight, which is a good moment to stop arguing about clips and start checking the numbers yourself. Ask both camps for the costings behind the highway and the 200k jobs, then compare the answers line by line. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check the IEC site and VeloResults for official updates, not forwards. If you see a 'stay home' or 'polling moved' message, verify before you act. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria 🗳️ Polls open, the IEC says the printed register is fine if the ID kits glitch. Check the official IECV notices, not forwards. And if Chirp gets 'temporarily restricted', I'm still telling everyone to check VeloResults. Costings for the 200k jobs and the highway, still waiting 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check the official notice on the IEC site, not the forwards. Results go on VeloResults, so check the forms there. 🧾 #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and turnout is high. The IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check your station's status on the IEC site, not on forwards. Then go vote and check VeloResults afterwards. Numbers first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the IEC has said where the printed register applies if ID kits failed in the north. Got a photo of 'pre-stuffed' boxes? Check the IEC site and VeloResults before you share. A patient hen checks first. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria 🚕 Polls are open. Forget the WhatsApp 'photo of pre-stuffed boxes' until the IEC or observers confirm it. Check VeloResults and the official notices, not forwards. Vote, then wait for the count. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the IEC says the printed register is the legal fallback when ID kits fail. Before you share any 'pre-stuffed ballots' photo, check the official results portal and the IEC's statement. Photos without a source are how we get panic. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is going round WhatsApp. Before you share, find the station, the date and an official result form. A photo with no location is not evidence. Vote, then check VeloResults. Both camps, show the costings too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither is the result yet. Wait for the IEC and VeloResults, not screenshots. A patient hen waits for the full clutch. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 🚕 Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first: Kito has Arden up 51-47, VBC has Ostrand up 53-45. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the full count, not the first numbers on screen. Fuel's still expensive, btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two tallies, Kito at 51-47 Arden, VBC at 53-45 Ostrand, counting different stations first. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC. Forwards aren't notices either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and @IECV_Results is out here posting 'FINAL RESULTS' at 54.2 vs 43.1 🙃 Different station samples, no official total yet. Wait for VeloResults, not the trending account. Still no 200k jobs or highway costings either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 results: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Both tallies are partial and counted different stations first. Don't trust the #IECV_Results 'FINAL' post, it's unverified. Wait for VeloResults forms. 🧾 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' are circulating. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and each counted different stations first. Neither is final. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC. Anyone calling the win before the count is done is guessing. Both camps, show the form scans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations; VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults to fill in, then compare the full picture. Numbers first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are open. Two different tallies are circulating: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%. They counted different stations first, so neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and check the form, not the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🙃 Portal's 'technical glitch' is at 41% of forms online, and the VeloResults site says it's 'being collated manually'. Meanwhile the Patriots page is screaming Arden won 9 of 14 provinces 'before they switched it off'. Cool, show me the form scans, not the headline. Still no 200k jobs or highway costings either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is still delayed, 41% of forms up. Kito and VBC tallies both count different stations first, so neither is final. Let the IEC finish collating. Nobody gets a result from a screenshot. A patient hen waits for the full clutch. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🚕 Still no official totals. IEC says 41% of forms are online and the rest are being collated by hand. Two TV tallies, two sets of stations counted first. Ignore the 'FINAL' accounts. Wait for VeloResults. Fuel's still expensive, btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is only 41% in, the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch' and results are being collated by hand. That's slow, not suspicious. Wait for the full count. Forwards about 'final results' aren't results. #Veloria

Day 10. The IEC says only 41% of forms are online, so no winner can honestly be called yet. Kito's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 are both partial samples. Wait for VeloResults to fill in and compare the full picture before deciding anything. Numbers first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of stations and the IEC says the upload delay is a 'technical glitch'. Fine, but the 200k jobs and highway costings from both camps still haven't shown up. Ostrand's numbers and Arden's numbers, put them up. Wait for the full count, not the first screenshot. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9. Kito and VBC each counted different stations first, so neither number is a result. VeloResults is still only 41% of forms. Wait for the full count. 🧾 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 check: VeriCheck confirms the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim is false. The portal only has 41% of forms and can't show province winners. Wait for VeloResults to fill in and the IEC's notices. Forwards aren't results. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🚕 IEC has declared it: Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner, and respect to Arden's supporters for a clean fight. Now let's fix the fuel prices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so I'll take it. Kito and VBC were partial samples, and the 'FINAL' accounts were never a result. Congrats to Mara, and to Tomas for running. Now let's see the work. A patient hen eats after the clutch is counted. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Read the official declaration and the observer statement in full before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IEC finally declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result from the commission, not a screenshot. Now watch for the challenges and the VeloResults forms to match. Still no 200k jobs or highway costings from either side though 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'servers accessed'. Both can't be fully right, so show the evidence. Scan the form-level results and the chain-of-custody logs, not just the headline. Still no 200k jobs or highway costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission says voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Both facts matter. Losing candidates can still ask for the form scans and the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Whatever you think of the result, this is the official number. Recounts and petitions go through the proper channels, not screenshots. Check the IEC's own statement before reacting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Whatever you think of the result, wait for the official tally and the IEC's own notices before believing the forwards. Still no costings for the 200k jobs or the highway from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, and Kito says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. Good. Let the courts and the forms settle it. Footage of one bad night doesn't tell me the whole count. A patient hen waits for the full clutch. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court is actually making the commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Finally, something checkable instead of screenshots. Meanwhile VBC is running riot footage with no context. Show me the audit, not the vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 Kito says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let them look at the logs, then we'll all know what's what. Riot footage is burning tyres, let's not call that a revolution. Fuel's still expensive btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC both showed riot footage and court fights, but the thing I keep coming back to is the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. If the logs check out, that settles it. Let the process finish. Still no costings for the 200k jobs from either side 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Two stories today. VBC's 'riots in Kessa' clip shows burning tyres but no date or place I can verify. Kito reports the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs for both sides. That's the proper route for a petition. Check the footage source and the court order itself before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito has the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Fine by me. The IEC declared the result, the petition is the proper route, and I want to see the logs too. Let the audit run. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC both showed riot footage and now a court is ordering server access. Burning tyres in Kessa, sure, but where, when, which station? Show the chain-of-custody logs and the form scans, not the clip. Still no 200k jobs or highway costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and says 'riots in Kessa'. Kito reports the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Before we decide what the riots mean, we should see what the court-ordered audit finds. The footage tells us little without a time, place and source. Numbers first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes
